metadata.title: The Escobar Constant for Two-dimensional Disks
metadata.abstract: Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth compact Riemannian surface homeomorphic to a closed disk, with boundary length $L$. We establish sharp upper bounds for its Escobar constant under upper bounds on the Gaussian curvature. If $K_g\leq 0$, then $I(M,g)\leq 2/\pi$, with equality if and only if $(M,g)$ is isometric to a Euclidean disk. If $K_g\leq\kappa$ for some $\kappa>0$, $L<2\pi/\sqrt{\kappa}$, and $\operatorname{Area}_g(M)<2\pi/\kappa$, then $I(M,g)\leq\frac{4}{\sqrt{\kappa}L}\arcsin(\frac{\sqrt{\kappa}L}{2\pi})$, with equality if and only if $(M,g)$ is isometric to the geodesic disk of the same perimeter contained in an open hemisphere of the sphere of constant curvature $\kappa$. We also discuss the higher order Escobar constant for planar domains. In particular, we construct counterexamples to Hassannezhad and Siffert's conjecture.

analysis.workSummary: 对光滑紧致且同胚于闭圆盘的黎曼曲面，证明K≤0时Escobar常数I≤2/π，等号恰为欧氏圆盘。若K≤κ>0、边界长L<2π/√κ且面积<2π/κ，则I≤4/(√κL)·arcsin(√κL/(2π))，等号恰为曲率κ球面开半球内同周长测地圆盘。另研究平面域高阶常数并构造猜想反例。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出由曲率上界控制的尖锐常数及完整圆盘等号判定。
analysis.limitations: 正曲率情形同时需要周长和面积限制；高阶反例的精确阶数及假设未在摘要列出。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
